title: Newly Discovered Dinosaur Named after British Dad
desc: A new species and genus of dinosaur has been named after a dad in Surrey, in the UK, according to BBC. Paludohadros proudlovii - an iguanodontian - was named in honor of the late Will Proudlove, who managed the Ewhurst brick and roof tile works where the dinosaur was discovered. Proudlove passed away at the age of 35, shortly before the dinosaur's fossil was found in 2001 and donated to the Natural History Museum. His wife Rachel told BBC Radio Surrey there was a history of finding dinosaur remains where the father-of-two worked.
